_om: Engelsk översättning av monster.json. Bara texter; siffrorna och tecknen står i den svenska filen. Varelserna kopplas ihop med sina id:n. Valen i val är substantivfraser, eftersom samma ord sätts in efter både du och en varelse eller vandrare (duell här, pvp_duell och pvp_vantar i texter.json).

dyker_upp: Something pale and many-legged crawls out of a crack. It has no eyes, but it turns towards you.
Something pale peels itself from the wall, where it lay so close you took it for part of the stone.
dor: The pale many-legged thing curls up and goes still. Beneath it lie a few coins.

dyker_upp: A snake, long as a man, rises from a heap of dust. It hisses and strikes at once.
A young, glistening snake lies coiled in the corner. It has already seen you.
dor: The long snake writhes one last time and then lies still. Gold glints in its belly.

dyker_upp: A figure in armour of overlapping scales steps forward. It holds a shield before it and waits.
A figure in scale armour stands motionless in the middle of the room. Its armour looks grown rather than forged.
dor: The figure collapses. The armour is empty, like a shed skin. Coins rattle out of it.

dyker_upp: A greenish shape glides forward. It wears an adventurer's clothes, but they hang in rags and are bleached, as if they had lain in acid.
Something rises out of the floor, greenish and translucent. It looks at your bag, as if it remembers what it was like to carry one.
dor: The greenish shape dissolves into a bitter mist. Left behind is the gold it never got out with.

dyker_upp: A being built of curved white bones rises up. The bones are all alike, like ribs from one and the same beast.
dor: The creature falls apart into a heap of ribs. Between them lies gold.

monster_traffar_anfall: {Monster} catches your blow and strikes back.
Your blow glances off {monster}, which strikes back.
monster_traffar_parera: You wait for a blow, but {monster} comes from the side.
monster_traffar_undan: You are too slow to get away.
bada_traffar: You strike each other at once.
inget: Neither of you reaches the other.
inte_beredd: You are not ready. {Monster} answers with {dess_val}.
fly: You turn and flee. {Monster} answers with {dess_val}.
seger: You have defeated {monster} and take {guld} gold.
strid_andra: Sounds of fighting in the {region} part of the tower.
inget_monster_har: There is nothing here to fight.
